simple.meaning: לָעֵג (lâʻêg) is a Hebrew word meaning “a buffoon ; also a foreigner.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לָעֵג (H3934) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 35:16, with occurrences in Psalms, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לָעֵג (H3934) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לָעֵג (H3934) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לָעֵג (lâʻêg) / H3934 is traced through Psalms 35:16, Isaiah 28:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3934. laeg [ לָעֵג ] adjective mocking , only plural construct as noun (si vera lectio), מָעוֺג לַעֲגֵי Psa 35:16 mockers of מָעוֺג (q. v.), but text dubious; Che reads לֹעֲגֵי Schw ZAW xi. 1890, 258 לָֽעֲגוּ . — To [ לָעֵג ] is also reffered לַעֲגֵי Isa 28:11 by Ges De Che Du, < below לַעַג q. v.
